collocations.example: As long as the family was together and healthy, Grandpa always said, everything was fine and dandy. （读后续写·亲情·知足）

collocations.translation: 好极了（有时反讽，表示"糟透了"）
collocations.example: 'Just dandy,' he muttered as the rain soaked through his last dry shirt — the very picture of a plan gone completely wrong. （读后续写·倒霉·反讽）

collocations.translation: 一个十足的花花公子；一件极好的东西
collocations.example: The vintage watch his grandfather left him was a real dandy, and he treasured it above every other possession. （读后续写·传家宝·珍视）
Dressed like a dandy from head to toe, the newcomer strutted into the classroom, utterly oblivious to the giggles rippling behind him. （读后续写·出场·喜剧感）

synonyms.example: The teacher praised her essay as excellent, singling out its vivid detail and heartfelt sincerity. （应用文/读后续写·评价·褒扬）
synonyms.usage: 正式、通用的"极好"，适用于书面与口语各种场合；dandy 是非正式、偏口语的美式说法，且带轻松或反讽色彩，正式写作慎用

synonyms.example: What a splendid idea it was to hold the reunion by the lake where we had all grown up! （应用文·感叹·赞美）
synonyms.usage: 比 dandy 更正式、更有感情色彩，常用于赞叹主意、景色、成就；dandy 更随意、口语化

synonyms.translation: （作名词）过分讲究衣着的男人，花花公子
synonyms.example: The vain young fop spent more on cravats and cologne than on books, and it showed in his empty conversation. （读后续写·人物·讽刺）
synonyms.usage: 作名词时与 dandy 同义，都指爱打扮、虚荣的男子，fop 贬义更重、更古旧；dandy 有时可略带欣赏或中性描述

advancedExpressions.expression: '... fine and dandy,' sb. said, but ...
advancedExpressions.example: 'Everything's fine and dandy,' he said with a shrug, but the way his gaze dropped to the floor gave the lie to every cheerful word. （"fine and dandy"+ but 反转揭示真实内心，续写心理刻画）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... turned out just dandy, and we are grateful for ...
advancedExpressions.example: The venue you arranged turned out just dandy, and we are truly grateful for all the thought you put into it. （轻松口吻的正向反馈，非正式感谢信/便条）

advancedExpressions.expression: to pretend everything is fine and dandy is to ...
advancedExpressions.example: To pretend that everything is fine and dandy while ignoring the cracks beneath the surface is neither honesty nor optimism, but mere self-deception. （"to pretend...is to..."下定义 + 反讽用 fine and dandy 揭示回避问题，议论文批判）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He said he was fine but he was not.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: 'I'm just fine and dandy,' he insisted with a wave of his hand, yet the hollow cheer in his voice and the shadow behind his eyes betrayed a grief he was too proud to name. （读后续写·强撑·心理反差）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 直接引语 fine and dandy 增口语真实感 + with a wave of his hand 动作细节 + yet 转折 + "hollow cheer""shadow behind his eyes"意象揭示真实情绪 + "too proud to name"点明性格

sentenceUpgrade.original: Not everything in life is perfect.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is comforting, no doubt, to tell ourselves that everything is fine and dandy; yet genuine progress begins only when we find the courage to face the flaws we would rather not see. （议论文·直面问题·文体升级）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 反讽引用 fine and dandy + "it is comforting to...yet..."让步转折 + "genuine progress begins only when"强调句式 + "flaws we would rather not see"收尾点题，逻辑递进

original_sentence: My momma said my back's crooked like a question mark.
readingExamples: My momma said my back's crooked like a question mark.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. bent or twisted, not straight or level
(2) adj. (of a person's back or limbs) curved out of the normal shape
(3) adj. (informal) dishonest, especially involving illegal or unfair dealings
(4) adj. not properly positioned; hanging or set at an uneven angle

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 不诚实的，欺诈的（熟词僻义·高考爱考）
uncommonMeanings.example: Everyone in the village had long suspected that the crooked official was pocketing the relief funds, yet no one dared to speak until the young reporter arrived with a folder of hard evidence. （读后续写·正义揭露）

posExamples.sentence: The old fisherman's fingers, crooked and gnarled from decades of hauling nets in the biting wind, trembled as he tied the last knot and pushed the little boat toward the open sea. （读后续写·人物刻画）
As you follow the crooked path winding up the hillside, please stay behind the wooden railings, for the loose stones near the cliff edge can be dangerous after rain. （应用文·参观须知）
A crooked ruler can never draw a straight line; likewise, a society built on dishonest dealings can hardly nurture citizens of integrity. （议论文·诚信主题）
She noticed that the framed photograph on the wall hung slightly crooked, and something about that small imperfection made the abandoned house feel achingly human. （读后续写·环境烘托）

collocations.translation: 歪斜的微笑（往往带点玩世不恭或羞涩）
collocations.example: He gave her a crooked smile, half apology and half mischief, and she found her anger melting away despite herself. （读后续写·情感转折）
The crooked path through the misty woods seemed to lead nowhere, yet Grandpa walked it with the calm certainty of a man who had come this way a thousand times. （读后续写·祖孙同行）
As a child she had hidden her crooked teeth behind her hand, but the day she won the debate, she smiled so widely that no one thought to look. （读后续写·自信成长）
Years of bending over the loom had left the weaver with a crooked back, but her spirit stood taller than anyone in the room. （读后续写·底层尊严）
The banner they had spent all morning putting up hung crooked in the breeze, and the whole team burst into laughter instead of frustration. （读后续写·集体活动）
With crooked fingers she pointed to a faded photograph on the mantelpiece, and her voice grew soft as the memories came flooding back. （读后续写·老人回忆）
The toddler proudly held up a page of crooked lines and swore it was a picture of the whole family. （读后续写·童真温情）
The company's crooked dealings finally came to light, and the scandal cost it every shred of public trust it had built over thirty years. （议论文·商业诚信）

synonyms.example: The bent nail refused to go into the wood no matter how hard he hammered. （读后续写·劳作细节）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:bent 强调被外力弄弯的具体物体,较口语;crooked 更强调不直、歪斜的整体形态,且可引申为不诚实,bent 无此贬义引申（英式俚语中 bent 亦可指腐败，但正式写作少用）

synonyms.example: The twisted branches of the ancient oak clawed at the grey sky like the fingers of some sleeping giant. （读后续写·环境渲染）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:twisted 强调经过扭转、缠绕而变形,画面更狰狞、有张力;crooked 只是弯、歪,程度较轻、语气较中性

synonyms.example: A dishonest word, once spoken, can undo years of painstakingly earned trust. （议论文·诚信主题）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:dishonest 是描述品行不诚实最直接、最正式的词;crooked 作"不诚实"讲时更口语、更带鄙夷,常指涉及违法牟利的腐败行为

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., crooked and worn, told a story of ...
advancedExpressions.example: His hands, crooked and worn, told a story of a lifetime spent giving to others and asking for nothing in return. （后置形容词+拟人化叙事，续写刻画人物过往）

advancedExpressions.expression: as the ... is crooked / uneven, please be sure to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the mountain trail is crooked and slippery in places, please be sure to wear sturdy shoes and stay close to your guide at all times. （提醒句式，通知/须知类应用文）

advancedExpressions.expression: a crooked ... can never ...; likewise, ...
advancedExpressions.example: A crooked foundation can never bear a towering building; likewise, a career founded on deceit can never withstand the test of time. （类比+分号并列，说理有力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old man's back was crooked.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The old man's back was bent crooked as a question mark, bowed by decades of toil, yet when the children ran to greet him, he straightened as though the weight of years had suddenly lifted. （读后续写·人物+情感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 明喻(crooked as a question mark，呼应课文原句) + 过去分词短语作状语(bowed by...) + yet转折对比(straightened) + 隐喻情感升华(weight of years lifted)

sentenceUpgrade.original: The official was crooked and stole money.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That the official was crooked came as no surprise to those who had watched public funds quietly vanish into private pockets year after year, but the courage of the whistle-blower who finally exposed him left the whole town in awe. （议论文/记叙·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: That从句作主语 + came as no surprise to sb.地道表达 + 定语从句(who had watched...) + 尾重信息(the courage...left...in awe)突出主旨

original_sentence: These are going to make me as straight as an arrow. They're my magic shoes.
readingExamples: These are going to make me as straight as an arrow. They're my magic shoes.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a thin straight weapon with a sharp point at one end, shot from a bow
(2) n. a sign or symbol shaped like an arrow, used to show direction or point to something
(3) n. (as a symbol of speed or straightness) something moving fast and in a straight line

posExamples.sentence: The arrow left the bow with a sharp whistle, cut clean through the frosty air, and buried itself in the very heart of the target, silencing the crowd that had doubted the trembling young archer. （读后续写·竞技高潮）
Once you enter the exhibition hall, simply follow the green arrows on the floor, and they will lead you smoothly from one section to the next without any confusion. （应用文·参观指引）
Time flies like an arrow, and every hour we waste in idleness is an hour we can never call back; this is why a clear plan matters far more than mere good intentions. （议论文·惜时主题）
She dashed across the finish line as straight and swift as an arrow, her ponytail streaming behind her, and only then did the tears she had been holding back finally break free. （读后续写·运动会）

idioms.example: Grandfather stood straight as an arrow at the gate every evening, waiting for the school bus, and to me that unbending figure came to mean love itself. （读后续写·亲情，兼取"正直"双关，呼应课文"as straight as an arrow"）
Everyone trusted him with the class funds, for he was a straight arrow who had never once bent the truth to serve himself. （读后续写·人物品格）

collocations.example: With one final breath she shot the arrow, and time seemed to slow as every eye followed its arc toward the distant target. （读后续写·紧张时刻）
The village elder taught the orphan boy to handle a bow and arrow, and in those quiet lessons the child slowly rebuilt a world that grief had torn apart. （读后续写·治愈成长）
To reach the first-aid room, please follow the red arrows along the corridor and turn right at the end. （应用文·校园指引）
A flashing green arrow on the screen pointed the anxious passengers toward the emergency exit. （读后续写·紧急场景）

collocations.phrase: an arrow points to / at sth
collocations.example: On the map, a bold arrow points to the mountain hut where climbers can shelter from sudden storms. （应用文·活动说明）
The messenger rode swift as an arrow through the night, carrying news that could not wait until dawn. （读后续写·紧迫叙事）
As the legend goes, a hail of arrows darkened the sky, yet the lone general never once turned his horse from the enemy. （读后续写·历史传说）
She drew a small arrow in the margin to remind herself which paragraph needed rewriting. （应用文·学习笔记）

synonyms.example: The child made a sudden dart across the road, and the driver slammed on the brakes just in time. （读后续写·惊险瞬间）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:dart 指较小的投掷利器（飞镖），也常作动词表"猛冲";arrow 特指配弓发射的箭，作名词还广泛指方向"箭头"，dart 无此指示义

synonyms.example: The teacher used a laser pointer to draw the class's attention to the key formula on the board. （应用文·课堂说明）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:pointer 泛指用来指示的工具或指针（钟表指针、教鞭、光标）;arrow 特指"箭头"这一符号形状，二者在"指示"义上有交叉，但形状与来源不同

advancedExpressions.expression: sb./sth. shot forward like an arrow released from the bow
advancedExpressions.example: At the starting gun she shot forward like an arrow released from the bow, every doubt of the past year burning away in the rush of wind. （明喻+动作特写，续写渲染爆发力）

advancedExpressions.expression: simply follow the arrows and you will find ...
advancedExpressions.example: Simply follow the arrows painted on the ground and you will find the registration desk right at the entrance of the gym. （祈使句+承诺结果，指引类应用文）

advancedExpressions.expression: time / opportunity flies like an arrow — once gone, it never returns
advancedExpressions.example: Opportunity flies like an arrow — once gone, it never returns; the wise, therefore, seize the moment while the foolish wait for a better one. （明喻+对比说理，惜时/机遇主题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The arrow hit the target.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With a sharp hiss the arrow tore through the still morning air and struck the bullseye dead centre, and for one breathless heartbeat the entire field fell utterly silent before erupting into cheers. （读后续写·竞技高潮）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟声开头(sharp hiss) + 连动(tore through...struck) + 时间凝滞描写(one breathless heartbeat...fell silent) + 先抑后扬(silent→erupting into cheers)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not waste time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Since time flies like an arrow that never returns, it is upon each of us to make every fleeting hour count rather than to squander our youth in idle regret. （议论文·惜时）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Since引导原因状语从句 + 明喻(like an arrow that never returns) + it is upon sb. to do 正式责任表达 + rather than 对比结构强化主旨

original_sentence: From that day on, we was always together. Jenny and me was like peas and carrots.
readingExamples: From that day on, we was always together. Jenny and me was like peas and carrots.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a small round green seed eaten as a vegetable, which grows inside a long pod on a climbing plant
(2) n. the plant on which these seeds grow
(3) n. (as a symbol of smallness or roundness) something very small and round

posExamples.sentence: Grandma sat on the porch shelling peas into a chipped enamel bowl, and the soft rhythmic patter of each pea dropping in seemed to carry away all the worries of the long summer afternoon. （读后续写·田园温情）
In our school garden project, each class will be responsible for a small plot, where students may grow peas, tomatoes and herbs, and learn firsthand where their food truly comes from. （应用文·活动方案）
A single pea, planted and patiently tended, can in time fill a whole basket; in the same way, a small kindness, once sown, may grow into blessings far beyond what we imagine. （议论文·积少成多主题）
From high above, the climbers on the ridge looked no bigger than peas scattered on a vast grey rock, and only then did I grasp how truly enormous the mountain was. （读后续写·景物+震撼）

wordForms.other: pea-sized (adj. 豌豆大小的); pea-green (adj. 豆绿色的)

idioms.idiom: (as) like as two peas in a pod
idioms.example: The twins were as like as two peas in a pod, and even their own mother sometimes paused before calling out a name. （读后续写·人物介绍）

idioms.idiom: like two peas in a pod
idioms.translation: 亲密无间，形影不离（形容关系或长相极像）
idioms.example: From that summer on, the two boys were like two peas in a pod, sharing every secret, every scraped knee and every wild dream. （读后续写·童年友谊，呼应课文"like peas and carrots"）

collocations.example: Shelling peas beside my grandmother, I learned that the slowest afternoons often hold the warmest memories. （读后续写·亲情回忆）
The steaming bowl of rice, dotted with bright green peas, was the first proper meal the refugees had seen in weeks. （读后续写·温暖救助）
The retired teacher grew peas along the fence, and every child in the lane knew they were welcome to a handful on the way home. （读后续写·邻里温情）

collocations.phrase: a pod of peas / peas in a pod
collocations.example: He split open the pod to reveal a neat row of peas, as tidy as buttons on a coat, and the little girl gasped in delight. （读后续写·童真发现）
A bowl of thick pea soup was waiting on the stove when she finally came in from the snow, and the simple warmth of it brought tears to her eyes. （读后续写·归家温暖）

collocations.translation: 豌豆和胡萝卜（喻形影不离、天生一对）
collocations.example: Ever since kindergarten the two of us had been peas and carrots — where one went, the other was sure to follow. （读后续写·挚友，直接化用课文表达）
Sweet peas climbed the old trellis in a riot of pink and lavender, filling the whole yard with their delicate scent. （读后续写·花园环境）

synonyms.example: The farmer soaked the beans overnight so they would soften in the morning's stew. （读后续写·农家生活）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:bean 泛指各类豆子（菜豆、黄豆等），种类范围大;pea 专指豌豆这种小圆绿豆，二者不可混用，pea 常用于"小而圆"的比喻

synonyms.example: She pressed a single seed into the warm soil and whispered a wish, as though the earth itself could hear her. （读后续写·希望象征）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:seed 是"种子"的统称，可作"起源、萌芽"的抽象比喻;pea 是具体食物豌豆，比喻义偏"细小圆形之物"，二者比喻方向不同

advancedExpressions.expression: no bigger than a pea / peas scattered on ...
advancedExpressions.example: From the plane the villages below were no bigger than peas scattered across a green quilt, and my quarrels of the morning suddenly felt very small. （明喻+以景喻情，续写升华心境）

advancedExpressions.expression: students will learn to grow ... such as peas and ..., gaining hands-on experience of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Through the farming club, students will learn to grow vegetables such as peas and tomatoes, gaining hands-on experience of patience and the joy of harvest. （介绍活动收获，倡议/通知类应用文）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as a single pea can fill a basket, so ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a single pea, once sown, can multiply to fill a basket, so a modest daily effort, faithfully repeated, can accumulate into remarkable achievement. （just as...so...类比句式，量变到质变主题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The two friends were always together.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From that day on, the two of us were like peas in a pod — inseparable through every triumph and every tumble, our friendship woven so tightly that not even the long years apart could ever unravel it. （读后续写·友谊升华，化用课文"like peas and carrots"）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 习语明喻(like peas in a pod) + 破折号补充(inseparable through...) + 对偶(triumph and tumble) + 比喻延伸(woven...unravel)呼应主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: Small efforts can add up to big results.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Just as a single pea, patiently planted and tended, can in time fill an entire basket, so too can our small, unglamorous daily efforts accumulate, season after season, into achievements we once thought beyond reach. （议论文·积少成多）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Just as...so too can...倒装类比结构 + 过去分词插入语(patiently planted and tended) + 副词短语控制节奏(season after season) + 尾句拔高(beyond reach)
